title: Polymorphism and Inheritance 1

lines.explanation: Manager class inherits all the properties of Employee class

The sub class (in his case Manager is subclass of Employee) can change the way it behave by 
overriding methods. The method 
work() is override here making Manager objects give a different 
response than Employee objects.
This method is new in class Manager. Employee objects don't have it.

Create an object of the Manager class. The reference employee is declared as Employee class, 
but the object is finally created 
as 
Manager.
This line prints out the class name of the employee object. Here, it prints Manager.

Although employee object is declared as being from Employee class, it is in fact a Manager 
object. This makes the object to use the override method and print "I am a Manager." The 
process goes as follows: i) the employee object is treated as being from the class Employee, ii) 
the work() method is found in the class Employee, but has been override by the real class the 
object belongs to (Manager), and iii) then method work is called in its override version.

This gives an error. The employee object is declared as Employee (even when is initialized as a 
Manager), and Employee class does not have the method manage().

This line will solve the last line problem. Cast the employee object to Manager class will make 
manager reference be treated as a Manager object in all cases.
This line prints out "I am a manager."
